shots.vo_line: Your cat's chewing your cords because of me.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat chews the white cable with eyes squeezed shut, tiny blue and yellow sparks crackling and flickering around his mouth, the cables trembling slightly. Static camera.
shots.speaker: The tooth

shots.vo_line: I am her tooth, and I'm begging you for help.
shots.motion_prompt: The tooth character sobs in place, shoulders shaking, as tears keep streaming down his face and his little arms tremble at his sides. Slow camera push-in.
shots.speaker: The tooth

shots.vo_line: Every day, soft food slides past me. Nothing scrapes. Nothing cleans.
shots.motion_prompt: The tooth character shrugs his thin arms helplessly, lip quivering and tears welling as he looks up, staying in place on the rug. Slow camera push-in.
shots.speaker: The tooth

shots.vo_line: Even dry biscuits crumble in seconds, so plaque hardens into tartar. I turn brown. I hurt.
shots.motion_prompt: The tooth character lies slumped on the biscuit heap, crying and sniffling, his body heaving with slow sobs as one arm slides limply down. Static camera.
shots.speaker: The tooth

shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle motion: the two tooth characters tremble in terror, staring ahead with quivering mouths, while the pink roof of the mouth glistens and the jaw trembles slightly. Slow camera push-in.
shots.speaker: The tooth

shots.motion_prompt: The small blob monster on the tongue grins wider and wiggles its lumpy arms, its glowing yellow eyes flickering, while the mouth stays wide open. Slow camera push-in.
shots.speaker: The tooth

shots.vo_line: "I'm Tartar! Nobody's coming? I grow and grow! Ha ha ha!"
shots.motion_prompt: The huge blob monster squeezes the tooth character tighter and laughs, its slimy body wobbling, while the tooth trembles and squirms in fear. Static camera.
shots.speaker: Tartar

shots.motion_prompt: The powder hero stands tall with fists on hips, cape billowing heroically and golden glow pulsing, as a confident grin spreads across his face. Slow camera push-in.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.vo_line: "I'm Meow Mouth. I'm coming to the rescue!"
shots.motion_prompt: The powder hero hovers in place as the glittering golden stream keeps pouring onto the blob monster, who recoils and shrinks back, while the tooth character cheers. Static camera.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.vo_line: Every dinner, I'm sprinkled on her food.
shots.motion_prompt: The scoop tips slowly as pale powder shimmers down onto the food, while the cat watches with wide eyes and perked ears. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.motion_prompt: The cat eats happily from the bowl, head bobbing gently as it chews with half-closed eyes, ears twitching softly. Static camera.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.vo_line: and I come back out through her saliva, working on plaque round the clock.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle motion: the glistening golden saliva wave washes slowly over the teeth as yellow plaque flakes lift off and dissolve into drifting sparkles. Slow camera push-in.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.vo_line: My brewer's yeast and bacon flavour mean even fussy cats clear the bowl.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat licks her lips contentedly and blinks slowly, settling more comfortably on the rug as the soft warm glow around her shimmers. Static camera.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.vo_line: I'm what her mouth has been missing.
shots.motion_prompt: The tooth character and the powder hero hug and sway happily side to side, both beaming, as little sparkles twinkle on the tooth's enamel. Slow camera push-in.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.vo_line: But humans gave her treats that are gone in seconds. That's why your cat chews cords. Her mouth's been crying out for help.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat looks down guiltily and slowly loosens his grip on the cables, while the powder hero pats his paw gently and looks up at him kindly. Static camera.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.vo_line: Her body knows what it needs. One scoop. Every dinner. Round the clock.
shots.motion_prompt: The clean tooth character beams and flexes his arms proudly, swaying gently in place, as star-shaped glints twinkle across his enamel. Slow camera push-in.
shots.speaker: Meow Mouth

shots.vo_line: Thousands of cat owners have already chosen Meow Mouth.
